requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 串口输入 READ：输出 HC-SR04（D8/D9）距离
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Hold io_1=false (no new valid distance). Provide one valid serial frame event with io_2_valid=true and io_2=1 for READ.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: serial_0_trigger=true in that control step, and serial_0_value_0 equals 0.0 when no previous valid distance has been captured.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 串口输入 READ：输出 HC-SR04（D8/D9）距离
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: First provide a valid ultrasonic sample: set io_1=true and io_0=12.34. Next control step, set io_1=false but keep io_0 arbitrary. Then provide one valid serial frame event with io_2_valid=true and io_2=1 for READ.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: serial_0_trigger=true in the READ step, and serial_0_value_0 equals 12.34 (last valid held distance).

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 串口输入 READ：输出 HC-SR04（D8/D9）距离
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Provide one invalid serial frame event with io_2_valid=false while io_2 is set to 1. Ultrasonic inputs may be any values.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: serial_0_trigger=false in that control step (no READ report).
